name: Work Your Mechanical Magic
source:
You are a robot, newly upgraded to feel strange human emotion. Will you stay a cog in the machine? Or find love in your fellow women?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4634620/Work_Your_Mechanical_Magic/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是一个机器人，刚刚升级可以感受人类奇怪的情感。你会留在机器中的一个齿轮吗？或者在你的女性同胞中寻找爱情？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4634620/Work_Your_Mechanical_Magic/]Steam[/url]]
